m_questTitle: A Chain of Ice and Fire

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: I have calibrated a new Pod to take us to the Dwarven island of Athanor. Once there, I can set up a Streamportal and network it to the others.
In theory, this network will allow us to Stream to any island in Empyrea where we first land a Pod. Similar to a World Door, but more localized.
Well done, Mr. Sparck. Stream us up, Wizard.
What a landing! I think we destroyed the Pod! Sparck - are we stuck here?
Negative, Captain. I've set up the Streamportal, and it is functioning perfectly. It can teleport us to Zanadu or Aeriel.
Good. Now let's take a look around. Natives! They don't look happy. Let's see what's wrong!
You fools! Don't you know what you've done, there?
So now this Medulla has the girl that could destroy the Spiral! Has our work here been for naught? Greys'in, what do you know of their plans?
Well, Bat always said they needed Mellori and her Luminiferous Essence to break the three Paradox Chains and free the Chaos Heart.
That's why they came to Zanadu - to learn how to extract that Essence. Now that they know, they'll make for one of the Chains. But which one?
Well, Bat did mention a scheme he was cooking up on Athanor... something about 'sowing chaos'. Oh! The Chain of Fire and Ice is there!
Then we must get to this Athanor place at once- oh wait... Does anyone know how we get to this Athanor place?
Captain, I have made great progress with my Streamportal network. I am relatively confident I can get us to Athanor from the Ark.
May the Light guide you, Captain Pork.
I owe you my throne, Wizard. Go make sure it wasn't for nothing.
